issues.failure_explanation: Proposition prop: OTmap-estimator-entropic proves that the modified entropic estimator satisfies Assumption asp: OTmap-estimator only for q>=1. The consistency proof uses q+2>=3 to get overline-alpha in [3,4] and a Lipschitz Hessian of the Brenier potential, which gives I_0<infinity. Corollary cor: fixedpoint-convergence-entropic assumes only Setting sett: algo-iteration, which allows q=0, and never states q>=1. For q=0 the cited proposition does not apply, so the corollary's reliance on it is unsupported as stated.

failure_location.quote: let the OT map estimator $\widehat{T}^{\mu,m}_{\nu,n}[\theta]$ be given by $\widehat{T}_{\mathrm{entr}}[\theta]$ defined in Proposition~\ref{prop: OTmap-estimator-entropic}

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add the hypothesis q>=1 to the corollary (and to the corresponding use of Setting sett: algo-iteration), or restrict the Setting to q>=1 when the entropic estimator is used. Alternatively, note that CM^q is contained in CM^1 for q>=1, so only the q=0 case needs to be excluded or treated separately.
issues.overall_effect: The a.s. convergence guarantee for the concrete algorithm with the entropic estimator is established only for q>=1, not for every q in N_0 as the corollary and Setting suggest.
issues.title: Corollary applies the entropic-estimator proposition outside its hypothesis q>=1 (Setting allows q in N_0)
issues.why_classification: A one-line hypothesis addition fixes it, and the substantive content of the corollary survives for the intended regularity regime q>=1.
